_comment: Everything actionc.py needs that task_all_actions.json does not carry.
'eval' holds arg_eval for the Task codes the JSON does cover, keyed code -> arg id;
an argument absent here has no arg_eval.
A string arg_eval is stored only where something reads it: a Boolean argument
(arg_type '3'), which actargs' Boolean case reads raw, or an argument whose arg_name
is empty, where arg_eval is the label itself.  Anywhere else arg_name wins, so a
string arg_eval beside a non-empty arg_name would be dead data -- 957 such values
were removed, changing no output.  A list arg_eval is always read.
'extra' holds the 325 entries Tasker does not publish at all (113 Event, 61 State,
132 unpublished/plugin Task, 19 Scene element), each a complete entry whose args are
[arg_id, arg_required, arg_name, arg_type, arg_eval].  An 'extra' entry also overrides
a published code outright, which is the escape hatch if one ever needs a redirect.
Regenerate additions with bldargs.py; see actionc.py for how this is loaded.

461t.16: Ask To Add If Not Present
